player_prompt.intro:
Aɖeke o, wò le Mastermind.
Wò xɔna kpodɔ sia ƒe kɔdi si wò nye {code_length} akɔnta kɔkɔe, akɔnta akɔkɔe tso 1 va ɖo {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Le wò ƒe gblɔgbamɛ, wò aƒe akɔnta sia ƒe gblɔgbamɛ le ƒormat sia me: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Le akɔnta ƒe gblɔgbamɛ ƒe megbe, wò aƒe ƒeɖoƒe le pegs ƒe ŋkɔ me.
Peg ƒe ŋkɔ si nye blɛ ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe akɔnta si nye kɔdi si nye kɔdi ƒe ŋkɔ me, eye peg ƒe ŋkɔ si nye ɣe ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe akɔnta si nye kɔdi si nye kɔdi ƒe ŋkɔ me gake nye kɔdi si nye kɔdi ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe ŋkɔ me.
Wò xɔ {max_turns} ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe akɔnta sia ƒe kɔdi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ate ŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu ake.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: siwo me womeŋlɔ wo ɖe eve o,

invalid_move.wrong_format: Menye xexlẽdzesi siwo wotsɔ nutatawo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ heƒo xlãe ɖe aklalati dzogoewo me ye nètsɔ ɖo eŋu o.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ele be xexlẽdzesi siwo katã woŋlɔ la nanye ame blibowo.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ele be xexlẽdzesi siwo nye {code_length} tututu nanɔ numedzodzroa me.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ele be xexlẽdzesiwo katã nanɔ 1 kple {num_numbers} dome.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Womelɔ̃na be woazã xexlẽdzesi eve o.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Ède dzesi {guess} xoxo. Taflatse dze agbagba nàbu eŋu kpɔ bubui.

game_action.feedback: Wò aƒe akɔnta sia ƒe gblɔgbamɛ [{guess}]. Ƒeɖoƒe: {black_pegs} peg ƒe ŋkɔ si nye blɛ, {white_pegs} peg ƒe ŋkɔ si nye ɣe.

outcome.win: Wò aƒe kpodɔ sia ƒe kɔdi, ƒe akɔnta {black_pegs} ƒe {code_length} pegs ƒe ŋkɔ si nye kɔdi si nye kɔdi ƒe ŋkɔ me
outcome.turn_limit: Mlɔeba la, èɖo wò mɔ̃a ƒe akpa si nye {percent} le alafa me dzi.
